For M1 and N1 category vehicles, under the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.

The stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

The S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

The S3 or S4 categories stop lamp devices shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
